description.value: The Canadian Grind is a coffee and tea café on 100 Avenue in Fort St. John, distinguished by an extensive loose-leaf tea catalog spanning over 135 varieties across categories including black, green, herbal, chai, matcha, oolong, and wellness blends. The shop also offers in-house café service and catering, making it a warm stop for cyclists passing through this northeastern BC hub city. Its tea-forward identity sets it apart from the typical roadside coffee stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thecanadiangrind.ca confirms the business name, address (9315 100 Ave, Fort St John, BC V1J 1X8), and phone (250-785-2711) all match OSM closely, establishing this as a real and active listing. No website content addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities, so OSM amenity tags (toilets=yes, internet_access=wlan, outdoor_seating=no) cannot be treated as authoritative per the stated rules. The in-house menu and catering pages both show 'coming soon' notices, suggesting a newer or still-developing operation, but the shop is clearly open and actively selling teas online.
concerns: In-house menu and catering pages both display 'coming soon' notices, suggesting the business may be newly opened or still building out its food offerings.
OSM tags toilets=yes and internet_access=wlan could not be confirmed via website content and are therefore left as null.
OSM outdoor_seating=no — no outdoor seating available per OSM, which may be relevant to cyclists preferring to sit outside with their bikes visible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating café in Fort St. John with corroborated contact details and an active website; a useful refreshment stop for touring cyclists on the northeastern BC corridor.
